items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: He said when he first moved to New York he was working at the same time with Paul Bley

ctx.x: But my love is what we’re talking about. My love is for the classic. And I’m not talking about — you know I heard a good interview with Steve Swallow. He said a beautiful thing. He said when he first moved to New York he was working at the same time with Paul Bley and at Nick’s with Dixieland guys. And he said a beautiful — with what’s his name the clarinet player, Pee Wee Russell. And he said a beautiful thing, he said you know those guys at Nick’s that I was playing with, I can’t say enough about them. They’re…
Well on that note I’m going to pause our recording and then we’ll say good-bye, all right?
